headline: Moroccan dirham depreciates against US dollar and euro as stocks extend losses
summary: Bank Al-Maghrib reported that the Moroccan dirham depreciated 1.7% against the US dollar and 0.6% against the euro between Nov 12 and Nov 17, with foreign reserves at MAD 512 billion.
why: Bank Al-Maghrib is the central bank of the Kingdom of Morocco.

impacts.name: US Dollar / Moroccan Dirham
impacts.why: Foreign exchange indicator updates confirmed a 1.7% fall in dirham value against USD.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Currency adjustments reflected broader US dollar strength against North African regional currencies.
